# ScreenCraft

> > ScreenCraft is a screenwriting education and competition platform offering craft advice, industry insights, and fellowship opportunities for aspiring and professional screenwriters.

The site features interviews with working screenwriters, practical writing advice, contest opportunities, and success stories from writers breaking into the industry. ScreenCraft connects writers with industry professionals in Los Angeles and beyond through fellowships, script services, and educational content.

## Key Topics

- Breaking into the industry
- Screenwriting craft and technique
- Character archetypes and development
- Narrative structure and storytelling
- Script coverage and notes
- ScreenCraft fellowships and contests
- Loglines and pitching
- Writing inspiration and motivation
- Industry professionals and networking
- Time management for writers
- Indie film distribution
- Screenwriter interviews
- First ten pages strategy
- Los Angeles film industry

## Essential Screenwriting Craft

- [Beat The Reader!!!](https://screencraft.org/blog/beat-the-reader): How to hook script readers in the critical first ten pages
- [Archetypes: To Use or Not To Use?](https://screencraft.org/blog/archetypes-use): Explores character archetypes and their role in screenwriting craft
- [Finding Time To Write](https://screencraft.org/blog/finding-time-to-write): Time management tips for screenwriters balancing writing with life
- [Screenwriting Secrets From About Time Writer/Director Richard Curtis](https://screencraft.org/blog/screenwriting-secrets-time-writerdirector-richard-curtis): Richard Curtis shares writing philosophy from BAFTA lecture on About Time

## Breaking Into the Industry

- [Breaking In](https://screencraft.org/blog/breaking): Success stories of first-time screenwriters like Michael Arndt & Stallone
- [How To Sell Your Indie Film & Actually Make Money](https://screencraft.org/blog/how-to-sell-your-indie-film-actually-make-money): Distribution strategies for indie filmmakers from Buffalo 8 Productions
- [Inside The No Budget Film Festival](https://screencraft.org/blog/inside-the-no-budget-film-festival): Interview about LA's No Budget Film Festival for microbudget shorts

## Screenwriter Interviews and Profiles

- [Exclusive: Interview with SNOWPIERCER Screenwriter Kelly Masterson](https://screencraft.org/blog/interview-snowpiercer-screenwriter-kelly-masterson): Kelly Masterson discusses adapting SNOWPIERCER with Bong Joon-ho
- [Interview with Action & Thriller Contest Winner Ken Miyamoto](https://screencraft.org/blog/interview-with-action-thriller-contest-winner-ken-miyamoto): Ken Miyamoto discusses winning Action & Thriller Contest and influences
- [Favorite Korean Filmmakers of the 2000s](https://screencraft.org/blog/favorite-korean-filmmakers-2000s): Profile of top South Korean directors from the 2000s era

## Writing Inspiration and Motivation

- [50 Great Screenwriting Quotes](https://screencraft.org/blog/50-great-screenwriting-quotes): Collection of 50 inspirational quotes from screenwriters and filmmakers
- ["Risk Making a Fool of Yourself"](https://screencraft.org/blog/risk-making-fool-yourself): Anne Rice quote on creative risk-taking in screenwriting

## ScreenCraft Fellowship and Community

- [ScreenCraft Screenwriting Fellowship Winners Los Angeles Itinerary 2014](https://screencraft.org/blog/screenwriting-fellowship-winners-itinerary): 2014 ScreenCraft Fellowship winners' LA itinerary and industry meetings
- [Jeff B. | Screenwriter in New York](https://screencraft.org/blog/jeff-b-screenwriter-in-new-york): Testimonial from NYC screenwriter Jeff B. on ScreenCraft services
- [David L. | Screenwriter in Los Angeles](https://screencraft.org/blog/david-l-screenwriter-in-los-angeles): LA screenwriter David L. testimonial on ScreenCraft script services

- [James Wong and Scott Abbott to Write Screenplay for Rosemary's Baby Miniseries](https://screencraft.org/blog/james-wong-scott-abbott-write-screenplay-rosemarys-baby-miniseries): NBC miniseries adaptation of Rosemary's Baby by Wong and Abbott
- [Disney to Revive Chip 'n' Dale as Live Action Feature](https://screencraft.org/blog/disney-revive-chip-n-dale-live-action-feature): Disney developing live-action Chip 'n' Dale feature with Robert Rugan
- [Liz Feldman to Write Script for Ellen DeGeneres' New Comedy](https://screencraft.org/blog/liz-feldman-write-script-ellen-degeneres-comedy): Liz Feldman writing NBC comedy pilot One Big Happy for Ellen DeGeneres
